rebuttal_or_critique: I must express my strong disagreement with the proposal to shift to a neutral stance. With an output gap of +0.70%, the economy is clearly operating above its potential, which inherently risks demand-pull pressures exacerbating the supply-side shocks we are witnessing in food inflation (6.56%). To shift to a neutral stance now would be premature and could be misconstrued as a signal that the MPC is lowering its guard against inflation. We must remain vigilant; the mandate is to durably align inflation with the 4.00% target. Given the volatility in global markets and the US Fed funds rate at 5.33%, any premature easing of our stance risks unanchoring inflation expectations, which would be far more costly to correct later. We must maintain the withdrawal of accommodation to ensure that the disinflationary process is not interrupted.
